fields.role: The job title or function of the person involved.
fields.operational_phase: The current stage of plant operation.
fields.access_level: The degree of access permitted to a specific area or system.
fields.high_pressure_reverse_osmosis_skids: Narrative requirements or rules specific to high-pressure RO skids.
fields.parameter: The specific system variable being monitored.
fields.target: The desired or ideal value for a parameter.
fields.threshold: The limit value that triggers a specific state or alert.
fields.consequence: The result or alert level triggered by a threshold breach.
fields.ro_feed_stream: The identifier for the reverse osmosis feed stream.
fields.measurement: The type of measurement being taken.
fields.metric_unit: The unit of measure for a value.
fields.min_bound: The minimum allowable value for a range.
fields.max_bound: The maximum allowable value for a range.
fields.required_correction: The action required to rectify a parameter deviation.
fields.time_allowance: The permitted duration to complete an action or resolve an issue.
fields.condition: The narrative trigger stating when a rule applies.
fields.action: The required response or result when a condition is met.

categories.AccessRequirement: Rules regarding who can access what.
categories.RampRateLimit: Limits on the rate of change for system parameters.
categories.StartupSequenceRequirement: Requirements for the order of operations during startup.
categories.StartupProcedure: General procedures for starting up systems.
categories.ConditionalShutdownRule: Rules for shutdown based on specific conditions.
categories.DataRetentionRequirement: Rules for how long data must be kept.
